limitations: SSR tests element content/attributes and source state, not browser font glyph bounds or actual animation readability.
Voice windows are real sentence envelopes and named cue frames only; this is not interior word alignment, ASR or human listening.
Actual no-subtitle 02–05 continuous clip and final MP4 must be independently decoded and viewed before media conclusions.
Exact audio PCM preservation, all-source freeze and full media checks belong to other responsible QA scopes.
Global start-frame shifts caused by the changed 03/04 duration are intentional; comparison uses the same local frames.
